capabilities: Render known [tag] markers as badges in Reading View
Render the same badges in Live Preview and the editor
Add a left accent to tagged headings, list items, paragraphs, and editor lines
Ignore Obsidian native callouts such as [!note]
extras: The README includes a release checklist and manual build steps aimed at developers; no screenshots or usage examples are shown. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Short inline status tags in planning notes and research logs are plain text that is hard to scan, and Obsidian has no built-in way to highlight them visually.
summary: Renders square-bracket planning tags like [now] and [trap] as readable badges in Reading View and Live Preview while keeping the Markdown unchanged.
